December 2019 |magazine=[[Rolling Stone]]}}</ref>

John played at the [[Western Sydney Stadium]] (Australia) on 7 March before the remainder of the tour was postponed indefinitely on 16 March due to the COVID pandemic.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Evans |first1=Mel |title=Elton John postpones 19 dates on Farewell Yellow Brick Road tour amid coronavirus |url=https://metro.co.uk/2020/03/16/elton-john-postpones-farewell-yellow-brick-road-tour-dates-amid-coronavirus-12407063/|access-date=17 March 2020 |website=Metro |date=16 March 2020|archive-date=17 March 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200317200255/https://metro.co.uk/2020/03/16/elton-john-postpones-farewell-yellow-brick-road-tour-dates-amid-coronavirus-12407063/|url-status=live}}</ref> In early 2020, John played piano on [[Ozzy Osbourne]]'s rock ballad "[[Ordinary Man (Ozzy Osbourne song)|Ordinary Man]]", released on [[Ordinary Man (Ozzy Osbourne album)|Osbourne's album of the same name]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Celebretainment |title=Ozzy Osbourne drops rock ballad Ordinary Man with Elton John |url=https://magicvalley.com/entertainment/music/ozzy-osbourne-drops-rock-ballad-ordinary-man-with-elton-john/article_38f5ad84-e5ea-500b-b7f2-8e2ae84073e1.html |access-date=25 November 2020 |newspaper=Twin Falls Times-News}}{{dead link|date=October 2022|bot=InternetArchiveBot|fix-attempted=yes}}</ref> On 29 May, his duet with Lady Gaga, "[[Sine from Above]]", from her album ''[[Chromatica]]'', was released.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Spanos |first=Brittany |date=29 May 2020 |title=Song You Need to Know: Lady Gaga feat. Elton John, 'Sine From Above' |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/lady-gaga-elton-john-sine-from-above-1005997/|access-date=11 June 2020 |magazine=Rolling Stone |language=en-US|archive-date=29 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200529201555/https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/lady-gaga-elton-john-sine-from-above-1005997/|url-status=live}}</ref>

John released ''[[Regimental Sgt. Zippo]]'' on 12 June 2021. Recorded as his debut album in 1968, the album was shelved in favour of 1969's ''[[Empty Sky]]'', and released vinyl-only in 2021 for [[Record Store Day]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Simpson |first=Dave |date=11 June 2021 |title=Elton John: Regimental Sgt Zippo review – the long lost 'trippy' album |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/jun/11/elton-john-regimental-sgt-zippo-review-long-lost-trippy-album |website=[[The Guardian]]|access-date=14 June 2021|archive-date=14 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210614070426/https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/jun/11/elton-john-regimental-sgt-zippo-review-long-lost-trippy-album|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 1 September 2021, John announced his new collaboration album ''[[The Lockdown Sessions (Elton John album)|The Lockdown Sessions]]'' which he made during the first [[COVID-19 lockdown]], which was released on 22 October 2021. Artists he collaborated with on the album include [[Eddie Vedder]], [[Miley Cyrus]], [[Dua Lipa]], [[Lil Nas X]], [[Gorillaz]], [[Nicki Minaj]], [[Young Thug]], [[Stevie Wonder]], [[Rina Sawayama]], [[Charlie Puth]], and [[Stevie Nicks]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John announces new album made with A-list guests in lockdown |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/sep/01/elton-john-announces-new-album-made-with-a-list-guests-in-lockdown |access-date=2 September 2021 |work=The Guardian |archive-date=2 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210902004354/https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/sep/01/elton-john-announces-new-album-made-with-a-list-guests-in-lockdown |url-status=live}}</ref> In a statement on the project, John explained: "I realised there was something weirdly familiar about working like this. At the start of my career, in the late 60s, I worked as a session musician. Working with different artists during lockdown reminded me of that. I'd come full circle: I was a session musician again. And it was still a blast."<ref>{{cite web |last=Beaumont-Thomas |first=Ben |date=1 September 2021 |title=Elton John announces new album made with A-list guests in lockdown |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/sep/01/elton-john-announces-new-album-made-with-a-list-guests-in-lockdown|access-date=1 September 2021 |work=[[The Guardian]]|archive-date=2 September 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210902004354/https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/sep/01/elton-john-announces-new-album-made-with-a-list-guests-in-lockdown|url-status=live}}</ref>

"[[Cold Heart (Pnau remix)]]", a collaboration with Dua Lipa, was released on 13 August 2021, as the album's first single. It peaked at number one in the UK in October 2021, becoming John's first UK number one in 16 years since 2005's "Ghetto Gospel".<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/oct/15/elton-john-scores-first-no-1-single-in-16-years-ending-15-week-ed-sheeran-run |title=Elton John scores first No 1 single in 16 years, ending 15-week Ed Sheeran run |last=Beaumont-Thomas |first=Ben |website=The Guardian |date=15 October 2021|access-date=15 October 2021|archive-date=15 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211015170703/https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/oct/15/elton-john-scores-first-no-1-single-in-16-years-ending-15-week-ed-sheeran-run|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-58933279 |title=Sir Elton John scores first number one in 16 years |website=BBC News |date=15 October 2021|access-date=15 October 2021|archive-date=15 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211015173632/https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-58933279|url-status=live}}</ref> With this hit, he became the first solo artist to have top 10 singles in the UK in 6 different decades.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/oct/13/elton-john-first-artist-uk-top-10-singles-six-decades |title=Elton John becomes first solo artist with UK Top 10 singles in six different decades |first=Laura |last=Snapes |date=13 October 2021 |work=The Guardian}}</ref> "Cold Heart" also peaked at number 1 in Australia in November 2021. At 74 years, 7 months and 14 days, John became the oldest artist to hit the top of the ARIA Singles Chart.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.aria.com.au/charts/news/elton-john-claims-record-breaking-aria-1-single |title=Elton John claims record-breaking ARIA #1 single |website=[[ARIA Charts]] |date=5 November 2021|access-date=11 November 2021|archive-date=2 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220802102836/https://www.aria.com.au/charts/news/elton-john-claims-record-breaking-aria-1-single|url-status=live}}</ref>

John contributed to the charity tribute album ''[[The Metallica Blacklist]]'', released in September 2021, by backing Miley Cyrus on a cover of the Metallica song "[[Nothing Else Matters]]".<ref>{{Cite web |last=He |first=Richard S. |date=10 September 2021 |title=Every Metallica Blacklist cover ranked from worst to best |url=https://www.loudersound.com/features/every-metallica-blacklist-cover-ranked-from-worst-to-best|access-date=24 October 2021 |website=loudersound |language=en|archive-date=26 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026061243/https://www.loudersound.com/features/every-metallica-blacklist-cover-ranked-from-worst-to-best|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 29 November 2021, John and Sheeran released "[[Merry Christmas (song)|Merry Christmas]]", a duet single for charity. Inspired by a scene from the 2003 romantic-comedy film ''[[Love Actually]]'', the song's music video sees the duo pay homage to scenes from past British Christmas hits, including "[[Last Christmas]]", "[[Walking in the Air]]", "[[Merry Christmas Everyone]]", and "[[Stay Another Day]]".<ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John, Ed Sheeran Pay Tribute to Holiday Hits in 'Merry Christmas' Video In January 2022, John continued his farewell tour for the first time since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, with his first show back taking place in New Orleans, Louisiana. To celebrate his 75th birthday in March 2022, John released a digitally remastered version of his ''Diamonds'' compilation album on streaming platforms.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Roper |first=Kerri-Ann |date=25 March 2022 |title=Sir Elton John says he's 'unbelievably lucky' as he celebrates 75th birthday |url=https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/sir-elton-john-birthday-unbelievably-lucky-b990404.html |access-date=25 March 2022 |website=Evening Standard |language=en |archive-date=25 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220325080732/https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/sir-elton-john-birthday-unbelievably-lucky-b990404.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Elton John: still standing at 75 |url=https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/944440-elton-john-still-standing-at-75 |access-date=25 March 2022 |website=The News International |date=25 March 2022 |language=en |archive-date=25 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220325064903/https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/944440-elton-john-still-standing-at-75 |url-status=live}}</ref>

In August 2022, John collaborated with [[Britney Spears]] on the song "[[Hold Me Closer (Elton John and Britney Spears song)|Hold Me Closer]]", which marked Spears' first new musical release in six years and her first release after the termination of her [[Britney Spears conservatorship case|controversial conservatorship]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Snapes |first=Laura |date=25 August 2022 |title='Britney was broken. It topped the charts in five countries and reached the top ten in 19 countries.<ref name="GAYTIMES">{{Cite web |last=Damshenas |first=Sam |date=5 September 2022 |title=Britney lands highest-charting single in the UK in 10 years with Elton John duet |url=https://www.gaytimes.co.uk/culture/britney-lands-highest-charting-single-in-the-uk-in-10-years-with-elton-john-duet/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220905105406/https://www.gaytimes.co.uk/culture/britney-lands-highest-charting-single-in-the-uk-in-10-years-with-elton-john-duet/ |archive-date=5 September 2022 |access-date=5 September 2022 |website=Gay Times}}</ref> The same month it was announced that John had written the music for a new musical about the life of televangelist [[Tammy Faye Messner]], with book by playwright [[James Graham (playwright)|James Graham]] and lyrics by [[Jake Shears]]. The musical, titled ''[[Tammy Faye (musical)|Tammy Faye]]'', opened at the [[Almeida Theatre]] in London, England in October 2022.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/stage/2022/aug/23/musical-tammy-faye-tells-gay-icons-life-story-with-score-by-elton-john |title=Musical Tammy Faye tells gay icon's life story with score by Elton John |date=23 August 2022 |first=Harriet |last=Sherwood |work=The Guardian}}</ref>

On 25 June 2023, John headlined the [[Glastonbury Festival 2023|Glastonbury Festival]]. Performing on the Pyramid Stage, John closed the festival with a two-hour performance which saw "Pinball Wizard" played live for the first time in over 10 years. The event drew in the festivals largest ever TV viewing figures in the UK with a peak of 7.6&nbsp;million and an average of 7.3&nbsp;million, the BBC also announced it had almost 50% of all viewers across all stations viewing the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=McLaughlin |first1=Charlotte |last2=Smith |first2=Steven |date=26 June 2023 |title=Glastonbury in numbers as Elton John's set draws magazine |url=https://www.rollingstone.co.uk/music/live-reviews/elton-john-live-at-glastonbury-review-the-perfect-farewell-30529/ |title=Elton John live at Glastonbury: the perfect farewell for an all On 8 July 2023, John performed the final concert of the tour in [[Stockholm, Sweden]] at the [[Tele2 Arena]]. Upon opening the show, John said: "Good evening Stockholm, well this is it".<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 July 2023 |title=Sir Elton John kicks off final date of his farewell tour |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/elton-john-stockholm-sweden-farewell-yellow-brick-road-billboard-b2371854.html |access-date=8 July 2023 |website=The Independent |language=en |archive-date=8 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230708202756/https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/elton-john-stockholm-sweden-farewell-yellow-brick-road-billboard-b2371854.html |url-status=live}}</ref> At the time, the tour was the [[List of highest-grossing concert tours|highest-grossing tour ever]]; it has since been surpassed by [[Taylor Swift]]'s [[Eras Tour]]. Though retired from touring, John has said that he will continue to "do the odd show" and is also in the early planning stages of recording a new album.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Roeloffs |first=Mary Whitfill |title='Farewell Yellow Brick Road': Elton John Bids Goodbye – After Record-Breaking Ticket Sales On Exit Tour |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2023/07/07/farewell-yellow-brick-road-elton-john-bids-goodbye---after-record-breaking-ticket-sales-on-exit-tour/ |access-date=8 July 2023 |website=Forbes |language=en |archive-date=8 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230708202756/https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2023/07/07/farewell-yellow-brick-road-elton-john-bids-goodbye---after-record-breaking-ticket-sales-on-exit-tour/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web  |title=Elton John shares an update on his next album |url=https://www.goodmorningamerica.com/culture/story/elton-john-shares-update-album-100236088 |access-date=8 July 2023 |website=Good Morning America |language=en |archive-date=8 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230708202756/https://www.goodmorningamerica.com/culture/story/elton-john-shares-update-album-100236088 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 1 October 2024, John made a surprise appearance during a United States premiere of his documentary, ''[[Elton John: Never Too Late]]'', at [[Alice Tully Hall]] in New York City as part of the [[2024 New York Film Festival|62nd New York Film Festival]]. After the screening, John appeared on stage, gave an update on his health and performed "Tiny Dancer". This was his first public performance since the end of his retirement tour.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://people.com/elton-john-says-never-felt-happiness-like-now-surprise-performance-never-too-late-new-york-premiere-8721569 |title=Elton John Says He's 'Never Felt Happiness Like I Have Now' as He Delights Never Too Late Crowd with Surprise Performance|access-date=2 October 2024 |first1=Raven |last1=Brunner |first2=Dayna |last2=Haffenden |first3=Marina |last3=Watts |work=People}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
=== Sexuality and family ===
In the late 1960s, John was engaged to be married to his first lover, secretary Linda Woodrow, who is mentioned in the song "[[Someone Saved My Life Tonight]]".<ref name=RS76>{{cite magazine |first=Cliff |last=Jahr |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/artists/davidbowie/articles/story/8718858/elton_john_its_lonely_at_the_top |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070611140600/http://www.rollingstone.com/artists/davidbowie/articles/story/8718858/elton_john_its_lonely_at_the_top |archive-date=11 June 2007 |title=Elton John: It's Lonely at the Top |magazine=[[Rolling Stone]] |date=7 October 1976 |access-date=25 February 2009 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="Myers">{{cite book |last=Myers |first=Paul |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=l118517OoewC&pg=PA133 |title=''It Ain't Easy: Long John Baldry and the Birth of the British Blues'' |date=6 September 2007 |publisher=Greystone Books, 2007 |isbn=978-1-55365-200-7 |page=133 |language=en |access-date=2 February 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210813214017/https://books.google.com/books?id=l118517OoewC&pg=PA133 |archive-date=13 August 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref> Woodrow provided financial assistance to John and Taupin at the time. John ended the relationship two weeks before their intended wedding, after being advised by Taupin and [[Long John Baldry]]. In 2020, John helped pay for Woodrow's medical fees upon her request, despite having lost contact with her 50 years previously.<ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John helps ex-fiancée, 50 years after jilting her |url=https://www.rte.ie/entertainment/2020/0606/1145852-elton-john-helps-ex-fiancee-50-years-after-jilting-her/ |access-date=6 June 2020 |publisher=[[Raidió Teilifís Éireann]] |date=6 June 2020 |archive-date=6 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200606145252/https://www.rte.ie/entertainment/2020/0606/1145852-elton-john-helps-ex-fiancee-50-years-after-jilting-her/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 1970, right after his first US shows in Los Angeles, California, John lost his virginity to and started his first gay relationship with [[John Reid (music manager)|John Reid]], the Tamla Motown label manager for the UK, who later became John's manager. The relationship ended five years later, although Reid remained his manager until 1998.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Storey |first1=Kate |title=Elton John and John Reid's Relationship Imploded After What We See in 'Rocketman' |url=https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/movies/a27573083/john-reid-elton-john-manager-rocketman-facts/ |website=Esquire |date=30 May 2019 |access-date=12 August 2019 |archive-date=16 June 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190616220225/https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/movies/a27573083/john-reid-elton-john-manager-rocketman-facts/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

John married German recording engineer, Renate Blauel, on 14 February 1984, in an extravagant wedding ceremony at [[St Mark's Church, Darling Point]], Sydney, Australia.<ref>[https://stmarksdp.org/app/uploads/Famous-weddings1.pdf Famous weddings] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240117000759/https://stmarksdp.org/app/uploads/Famous-weddings1.pdf |date=17 January 2024 }} [[St Mark's Church, Darling Point]].</ref><ref name="Renate" /> Blauel said she attempted suicide during their honeymoon in [[St-Tropez]] after John told her that he wanted to end the union.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Savage |first=Mark |date=25 August 2020 |title=Elton John's ex-wife 'attempted suicide' during their honeymoon |publisher=[[BBC]] |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-53907669|access-date=26 August 2020|archive-date=25 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825234528/https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-53907669|url-status=live}}</ref> Their marriage ended in divorce in 1988. John stated: "She was the classiest woman I've ever met, but it wasn't meant to be. I was living a lie."<ref name="Renate">{{cite magazine |first=Julie |last=Miller |title=Rocketman: Elton John's Forgotten 1984 Wedding to Renate Blauel |url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2019/05/rocketman-movie-elton-john-wife-wedding-renate-blauel |date=31 May 2019|access-date=1 June 2020 |magazine=[[Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]|archive-date=24 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200924160234/https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2019/05/rocketman-movie-elton-john-wife-wedding-renate-blauel|url-status=live}}</ref> In 2020, Blauel sued John for writing about their relationship in his 2019 ''Me: Elton John Official Autobiography'', which she claimed broke the terms of their divorce agreement.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Jones |first=Damian |date=13 August 2020 |title=Elton John's ex-wife Renate Blauel is suing the singer over relationship details in his autobiography |url=https://www.nme.com/news/music/elton-johns-ex-wife-renate-blauel-is-suing-the-singer-over-relationship-details-in-his-autobiography-2713600|access-date=26 August 2020 |newspaper=[[NME]] |language=en-GB|archive-date=15 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200915130559/https://www.nme.com/news/music/elton-johns-ex-wife-renate-blauel-is-suing-the-singer-over-relationship-details-in-his-autobiography-2713600|url-status=live}}</ref> The case was settled later the same year.<ref>{{Cite news |date=14 October 2020 |title=Sir Elton John and ex-wife Renate Blauel resolve legal dispute |language=en-GB |work=BBC News |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-54544607|access-date=14 February 2022}}</ref>

John had come out as [[bisexual]] in a 1976 interview with ''[[Rolling Stone]]''.<ref name=RS76 /><ref name=Myers /> In 1992, he told ''Rolling Stone'' in another interview that he was "quite comfortable about being gay".<ref>{{cite book |first1=Mary |last1=Rhiel |first2=David Bruce |last2=Suchoff |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1o8YQZQhqGoC&pg=PA23 |title=The seductions of biography |page=23 |publisher=Routledge |location=Abingdon, England |year=1996 |access-date=2 February 2010 |isbn=978-0-415-91090-3 |archive-date=15 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210815173307/https://books.google.com/books?id=1o8YQZQhqGoC&pg=PA23 |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 1987, John won a libel case against ''[[The Sun (United Kingdom)|The Sun]]'', which published false allegations that he had had sex with [[rent boys]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/media/2006/feb/16/sundaytimes.pressandpublishing |title=Elton settles Times libel case |work=The Guardian |location=London |access-date=26 May 2010 |date=16 February 2006 |first=Claire |last=Cozens |archive-date=15 December 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131215221637/http://www.theguardian.com/media/2006/feb/16/sundaytimes.pressandpublishing |url-status=live}}</ref>

[[File:Elton John Rocketman premiere 2019.jpg|thumb|upright=1.4|right|John with his husband [[David Furnish]] at [[Leicester Square]] in May 2019 for the London premiere of John's biopic film ''[[Rocketman (film)|Rocketman]]'']]
In 1993, John began a relationship with [[David Furnish]], a former advertising executive and now filmmaker originally from [[Toronto]], Canada. On 21 December 2005 (the day the [[Civil Partnership Act]] came into force), John and Furnish were among the first couples to form a [[civil partnership in the United Kingdom]], which was held at the [[Windsor Guildhall]].<ref>{{cite news |work=The Independent |date=8 October 2012 |first=Elton |last=John |title=The historic fight for equality must go on. Let's get on and legalise same-sex marriage |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/voices/comment/elton-john-the-historic-fight-for-equality-must-go-on-lets-get-on-and-legalise-samesex-marriage-8202686.html |location=London |access-date=27 August 2017 |archive-date=26 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150926000756/http://www.independent.co.uk/voices/comment/elton-john-the-historic-fight-for-equality-must-go-on-lets-get-on-and-legalise-samesex-marriage-8202686.html |url-status=live}}</ref> After [[same-sex marriage in the United Kingdom|same-sex marriage]] became legal in the United Kingdom in March 2014, John and Furnish married in [[Windsor, Berkshire]], on 21 December 2014, the ninth anniversary of their civil partnership.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-30568634 |title=Sir Elton John and David Furnish marry |work=BBC News |date=21 December 2014 |access-date=21 December 2014 |archive-date=21 December 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141221124416/http://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-30568634 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Sir Elton John's wedding: 11 things you might have missed |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/celebritynews/11309195/Sir-Elton-Johns-wedding-11-things-you-might-have-missed.html |work=The Daily Telegraph |location=London |first=Helena |last=Kealey |date=22 December 2014 |access-date=3 April 2018 |archive-date=19 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180619083448/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/celebritynews/11309195/Sir-Elton-Johns-wedding-11-things-you-might-have-missed.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John, David Furnish get married |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2014/12/21/showbiz/elton-john-wedding/ |publisher=CNN|date=21 December 2014 |access-date=24 December 2014 |archive-date=26 August 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150826172435/http://edition.cnn.com/2014/12/21/showbiz/elton-john-wedding/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2009, John expressed his wish to adopt an HIV-positive boy from a Ukrainian orphanage, but officials refused, saying that John was too old for the child and that adoption by unmarried couples was not allowed (specifying that same-sex marriages were not legally recognised by Ukraine).<ref>{{cite news |last1=Pidd |first1=Helen |title=Elton John's wish to adopt faces rejection |url=https://www.theguardian.com/society/2009/sep/14/elton-john-not-allowed-adoption |access-date=23 June 2025 |work=The Guardian |date=14 September 2009}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John blocked from adopting HIV-positive Ukrainian child |url=https://www.theguardian.com/society/2009/sep/14/elton-john-adoption-ukraine |access-date=23 June 2025 |work=The Guardian |agency=Associated Press |date=14 September 2009}}</ref>

John and Furnish have two sons.<ref>{{cite news |first=Ainhoa |last=Barcelona |title=There are no words to describe how much we love these boys': Elton John on his adorable sons |url=https://www.hellomagazine.com/celebrities/2016011829310/elton-john-amazing-beautiful-sons/ |work=Hello |date=17 December 2017|access-date=17 December 2017|archive-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180619063650/https://www.hellomagazine.com/celebrities/2016011829310/elton-john-amazing-beautiful-sons/|url-status=live}}</ref> The elder, Zachary Jackson Levon Furnish-John, was born via [[surrogacy]] on 25 December 2010, in California.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.usmagazine.com/momsbabies/news/sir-elton-john-and-david-furnish-welcome-a-new-baby–20102712 |title=Sir Elton John and David Furnish Welcome a New Baby! |work=Us Weekly |date=27 December 2010 |access-date=27 December 2010}}{{dead link|date=November 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{cite magazine |last=Levy |first=Glen |url=https://newsfeed.time.com/2010/12/28/welcome-tiny-dancer-elton-john-becomes-a-dad/ |title=Welcome, Tiny Dancer: Elton John Becomes a Dad |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304073304/http://newsfeed.time.com/2010/12/28/welcome-tiny-dancer-elton-john-becomes-a-dad/ |archive-date=4 March 2016 |magazine=[[Time (magazine)|Time]] |date=28 December 2010 |url-status=live |access-date=28 December 2010}}</ref> The younger, Elijah Joseph Daniel Furnish-John, was born on 11 January 2013, via the same surrogate.<ref>{{cite news |title=Proud father Sir Elton John introduces baby Elijah to the world |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/celebritynews/9830897/Proud-father-Sir-Elton-John-introduces-baby-Elijah-to-the-world.html |access-date=28 October 2018 |work=The Telegraph |archive-date=29 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181029071514/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/celebritynews/9830897/Proud-father-Sir-Elton-John-introduces-baby-Elijah-to-the-world.html |url-status=live}}</ref> John also has ten [[godchildren]], including [[Sean Lennon]], [[David Beckham|David]] and [[Victoria Beckham]]'s sons [[Brooklyn Beckham|Brooklyn]] and [[Romeo Beckham|Romeo]], [[Elizabeth Hurley]]'s son [[Damian Hurley]], and [[Seymour Stein]]'s daughter.<ref name="Warren">{{cite book |first=Holly |last=George-Warren |title=The Rolling stone encyclopedia of rock & roll |page=501 |publisher=Fireside |year=2001}}</ref>

The ''[[Los Angeles Times]]'' described John as a "self-declared [[atheist]]."<ref>{{cite web |last1=D'Zurilla |first1=Christie |title=Elton John slams Vatican for blessing its 'Rocketman' investment but not gay marriage |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/music/story/2021-03-16/elton-john-vatican-gay-marriage-rocketman |website=Los Angeles Times |access-date=11 July 2024 |date=16 March 2021}}</ref> In 2000, John characterised the [[Catholic Church and homosexuality|beliefs of the Roman Catholic Church on homosexuality]] as "ignorance" after a priest stated homosexuals engage in "a lifestyle that can never respond to the deepest longings of the human heart." He further stated, in a 2006 interview with ''[[The Observer]]'', that he would "ban religion completely, even though there are some wonderful things about it" and that "religion has always tried to turn hatred toward gay people" and "turns people into hateful lemmings and it is not really compassionate." [[Reuters]] reported John admired the teachings of [[Jesus Christ]], but was critical of [[organised religion]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Elton John wants "hateful" religion banned |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-elton/elton-john-wants-hateful-religion-banned-idUSL1288329720061112/ |work=Reuters |date=9 August 2007 |access-date=11 July 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Knickelbine |first1=Scott |title=Elton John |url=https://ffrf.org/publications/day/elton-john/ |website=Freedom From Religion Foundation |access-date=12 July 2024 |date=25 March 1980}}</ref> In 2010, some Christian groups in the US criticised John after he described Jesus as a "compassionate, super-intelligent gay man who understood human problems". [[Bill Donohue]], president of the [[Catholic League for Religious and Civil Rights]] and opponent of gay marriage, responded: "To call Jesus a homosexual is to label him a sexual deviant. But what else would we expect from a man who previously said, 'From my point of view, I would ban religion completely.{{' "}}<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2010/feb/19/elton-john-jesus-gay |title=Sir Elton John claims Jesus was gay |work=The Guardian |location=London |date=19 February 2010 |access-date=8 March 2015 |first=Adam |last=Gabbatt |archive-date=22 December 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141222004615/http://www.theguardian.com/music/2010/feb/19/elton-john-jesus-gay |url-status=live}}</ref> John stated, in his 2019 autobiography ''Me'', that he had received many death threats as a result of his statements. [[Neal Horsley]], a [[Christian Reconstructionist]] from [[Bremen, Georgia]], United States, was arrested for making terrorist threats, after posting a YouTube video stating: "We're here today to remind Elton John that he has to die".<ref>{{Cite magazine |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/georgia-man-arrested-for-threatening-elton-johns-life-64941/ |title=Georgia Man Arrested for Threatening Elton John's Life |magazine=Rolling Stone |date=12 March 2010|access-date = 27 December 2019|archive-date = 9 November 2019|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20191109113221/https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/georgia-man-arrested-for-threatening-elton-johns-life-64941/|url-status = live}}</ref> The charges were subsequently dropped.<ref name="advocate-elton">{{Cite news |url=https://www.advocate.com/arts-entertainment/entertainment-news/2010/06/15/charges-dropped-man-who-threatened-elton-john |title=Charges Dropped for Man Who Threatened Elton John |last=Bolcer |first=Julie |date=15 June 2010 |work=June 15, 2010 |access-date=27 December 2019 |archive-date=27 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191227170844/https://www.advocate.com/arts-entertainment/entertainment-news/2010/06/15/charges-dropped-man-who-threatened-elton-john |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2008, John said he preferred civil partnerships to marriage for gay people,<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.frontiersmedia.com/frontiers-blog/2014/12/22/sir-elton-john-david-furnish-get-married-sharethelove/ |title=Sir Elton John and David Furnish Get Married, #ShareTheLove |date=22 December 2014 |access-date=8 March 2015 |first=Karen |last=Ocamb |work=Frontiers Media |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402163706/http://www.frontiersmedia.com/frontiers-blog/2014/12/22/sir-elton-john-david-furnish-get-married-sharethelove/ |archive-date=2 April 2015 |url-status=dead}}</ref> but by 2012 he had changed his position and become a supporter of [[same-sex marriage in the United Kingdom]]. John said: <blockquote>"There is a world of difference between calling someone your 'partner' and calling them your 'husband'. 'Partner' is a word that should be preserved for people you play tennis with, or work alongside in business. It doesn't come close to describing the love that I have for David, and he for me. In contrast, 'husband' does".<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/voices/comment/elton-john-the-historic-fight-for-equality-must-go-on-lets-get-on-and-legalise-samesex-marriage-8202686.html |title=Elton John: The historic fight for equality must go on. Let's get on and legalise same-sex marriage |date=8 October 2012 |access-date=29 August 2013 |location=London |first=Elton |last=John |work=The Independent |archive-date=26 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150926000756/http://www.independent.co.uk/voices/comment/elton-john-the-historic-fight-for-equality-must-go-on-lets-get-on-and-legalise-samesex-marriage-8202686.html |url-status=live}}</ref></blockquote>

In 2014, John said Jesus would have been in favour of same-sex marriage.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://blogs.telegraph.co.uk/news/timstanley/100278074/elton-john-says-jesus-wouldve-backed-gay-marriage-millions-will-presume-hes-right/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140702214807/http://blogs.telegraph.co.uk/news/timstanley/100278074/elton-john-says-jesus-wouldve-backed-gay-marriage-millions-will-presume-hes-right/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=2 July 2014 |title=Elton John says Jesus would've backed gay marriage. Millions will presume he's right |date=30 June 2014 |access-date=4 July 2014 |location=London |first=Tim |last=Stanley |work=The Telegraph}}</ref>

=== Wealth ===
[[File:Tree lined drive to Woodside - geograph.org.uk - 555506.jpg|thumb|right|upright=1.2|The tree-lined drive to John's home in [[Woodside, Old Windsor|Woodside]] in [[Old Windsor]], Berkshire]]

In April 2009, the ''[[Sunday Times Rich List]]'' estimated John's wealth at £175{{nbsp}}million ({{US$|265 million}}) and ranked him the 322nd wealthiest person in Britain.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://business.timesonline.co.uk/tol/business/specials/rich_list/rich_list_2009/article6023877.ece |title=Search the Sunday Times Rich List 2009 |work=The Times |location=London |date=26 April 2009 |access-date=29 April 2009 |archive-date=31 August 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110831203054/http://business.timesonline.co.uk/tol/business/specials/rich_list/rich_list_2009/article6023877.ece |url-status=dead}}</ref> A decade later, John was estimated to have a fortune of £320{{nbsp}}million in the 2019 ''Sunday Times Rich List'', making him one of the 10 wealthiest people in the British music industry.<ref>{{cite news |last=Mee |first=Emily |title=Who made the Sunday Times Rich List this year? |url=https://news.sky.com/story/who-made-the-sunday-times-rich-list-this-year-11717733 |access-date=30 December 2019 |publisher=Sky News |date=14 May 2019 |archive-date=13 May 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200513223508/https://news.sky.com/story/who-made-the-sunday-times-rich-list-this-year-11717733 |url-status=live}}</ref> Aside from his main home, [[Woodside, Old Windsor|Woodside]], in [[Old Windsor]], Berkshire, John owns residences in: [[Atlanta]], Georgia (US); London, England; Los Angeles, California; [[Nice]], France and [[Venice]], Italy. His property in Nice is on Mont Boron. John is an art collector and is believed to have one of the largest private photography collections in the world.<ref>{{cite news |access-date=3 March 2008 |url=https://www.abcnews.go.com/US/story?id=3658634&page=1 |title=Art or Porn? Elton John's Photos Seized |work=ABC News |archive-date=8 February 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080208110456/http://abcnews.go.com/US/story?id=3658634&page=1 |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2000, John admitted to spending £30{{nbsp}}million in just under two years—an average of £1.5{{nbsp}}million a month. Between January 1996 and September 1997, he spent more than £9.6m on property and £293,000 on flowers.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/1024745.stm |title=Sir Elton's £30m spending spree |work=BBC News |date=15 November 2000 |access-date=25 February 2009 |archive-date=5 August 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170805093907/http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/1024745.stm |url-status=live}}</ref> In June 2001, John sold twenty of his cars at [[Christie's]] auction house, saying he never had the chance to drive them because he was out of the country so often.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/entertainment/showbiz/1283409.stm |title=Sir Elton to sell classic cars |access-date=3 February 2010 |date=18 April 2001 |work=BBC News |archive-date=5 April 2003 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030405121351/http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/entertainment/showbiz/1283409.stm |url-status=live}}</ref> The sale, which included a 1993 [[Jaguar XJ220]], the most expensive at £234,750, and several [[Ferrari]]s, [[Rolls-Royce Limited|Rolls-Royces]], and [[Bentley]]s, raised nearly £2{{nbsp}}million.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.classics.com/eltjohn.html |title=Classics.com Elton John's Cars to be auctioned at Christie's |publisher=classics.com |access-date=3 February 2010 |archive-date=10 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210210222817/http://www.classics.com/eltjohn.html |url-status=live}}</ref> In 2003, John sold the contents of his Holland Park home – expected to fetch £800,000 at [[Sotheby's]] — to modernise the decoration and to display some of his contemporary art collection.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/entertainment/3104246.stm |title=Sir Elton to sell home's contents |work=BBC News |access-date=27 September 2014 |date=13 September 2003 |archive-date=10 August 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130810192517/http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/entertainment/3104246.stm |url-status=live}}</ref> Every year since 2004, John has opened a shop called "Elton's Closet", in which he sells his secondhand clothes.<ref>{{cite news |date=12 April 2006 |title=Elton John turns rags to riches for charity |url=http://www.theage.com.au/news/people/elton-john-turns-rags-to-riches-for-charity/2006/04/11/1144521337887.html |url-status=live |access-date=25 February 2009 |work=The Age |location=Melbourne, Australia |agency=Associated Press}}</ref>{{update inline|date=August 2023}}

In October 2021, John was named in the [[Pandora Papers]], which allege a secret financial deal of politicians and celebrities, using [[tax havens]], in an effort to avoid the payment of owed taxes.<ref>{{cite news |last=Roxborough |first=Scott |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/elton-john-shakira-ringo-starr-pandora-papers-tax-1235024840/ |title=Elton John, Shakira Named in Pandora Papers as U.K. and Australia Call for Review of Leaked Tax Shelter Documents |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=4 October 2021 |access-date=4 October 2021 |archive-date=4 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211004143709/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/elton-john-shakira-ringo-starr-pandora-papers-tax-1235024840/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Other ===
[[File:Elton John November 2015.jpg|thumb|upright|John wearing a [[remembrance poppy]] in 2015]]A longtime tennis enthusiast, in 1975, he released the song "[[Philadelphia Freedom (song)|Philadelphia Freedom]]" in tribute to his friend [[Billie Jean King]]'s [[World Team Tennis]] team, the [[Philadelphia Freedoms (1974)|Philadelphia Freedoms]].<ref name="Billboard charts" /> King was a player-coach for the team at the time. John and King remain friends and co-host an annual pro-am event to benefit AIDS charities, most notably the [[Elton John AIDS Foundation]], of which King is a chairperson. John, who maintains a part-time residence in Atlanta, Georgia, became a fan of the [[Atlanta Braves]] baseball team, when he moved there in 1991.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://mlb.mlb.com/content/printer_friendly/mlb/y2007/m09/d05/c2191343.jsp |title=Elton John goes to bat with Braves |publisher=Major League Baseball |access-date=31 January 2010 |archive-date=24 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210224025919/http://mlb.mlb.com/content/printer_friendly/mlb/y2007/m09/d05/c2191343.jsp |url-status=live}}</ref>

John has appeared in commercials for [[Diet Coke]] (beginning in 1990), the [[Royal Mail]], [[Snickers]] and [[John Lewis & Partners]] department store, among others. Authors Roger Blackwell and Tina Stephan wrote "the relationship of Elton John and Diet Coke is one of the classic success stories in the role of sponsorship in brand building."<ref>{{cite book |title=Brands That Rock: What Business Leaders Can Learn from the World of Rock and Roll |date=2004 |publisher=[[John Wiley & Sons]] |location=Hoboken, New Jersey |page=56}}</ref> His 2018 [[John Lewis & Partners Christmas advert]] shown in the UK, titled "The Boy & The Piano", sees him reminisce about his life and career in reverse, culminating with Christmas Day in the 1950s when he received a piano for Christmas from his mother.<ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John's Christmas Commercial Is an Emotional Experience |url=https://www.eonline.com/uk/news/987718/elton-john-s-christmas-commercial-is-an-emotional-experience |access-date=4 June 2020 |publisher=E! |archive-date=4 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200604012706/https://www.eonline.com/uk/news/987718/elton-john-s-christmas-commercial-is-an-emotional-experience |url-status=live}}</ref>

An admirer of [[Monty Python]], he was among a group of musicians who helped finance their film ''[[Monty Python and the Holy Grail]]'' (1975).<ref>{{cite news |last=O'Neill |first=Phelim |date=9 March 2002 |title=Snake Charmer-Monty Python And The Holy Grail was Terry Gilliam's first film as a director. Here he remembers how he taught the nation to laugh at castles |work=[[The Guardian]] |url=https://www.theguardian.com/film/2002/mar/09/features.phelimoneill |url-status=live |access-date=5 September 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190905112428/https://www.theguardian.com/film/2002/mar/09/features.phelimoneill |archive-date=5 September 2019}}</ref> At the [[2nd Empire Awards]], in 1997, John presented the comedy group the [[Empire Inspiration Award]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Douglas |first1=McCall |title=Monty Python: A Chronology, 1969–2012 |date=2013 |publisher=McFarland |edition=2nd |page=181}}</ref>

John performed "Don't Let the Sun Go Down on Me," at the memorial service for Australian cricketer [[Shane Warne]], on 30 March 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=30 March 2022 |title=A reported one billion people watched Shane Warne's memorial service in Melbourne |url=https://www.givemesport.com/87990038-shane-warne-memorial-1-billion-people-tune-in-to-bid-cricket-legend-farewell |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220331170948/https://www.givemesport.com/87990038-shane-warne-memorial-1-billion-people-tune-in-to-bid-cricket-legend-farewell |archive-date=31 March 2022 |access-date=31 March 2022 |website=GiveMeSport }}</ref>

John is among the people interviewed for the documentary film ''[[If These Walls Could Sing]]'' directed by [[Mary McCartney]] about the recording studios at [[Abbey Road Studios|Abbey Road]] which premiered in November 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=If These Walls Could Sing Premieres At Abbey Road |url=https://www.abbeyroad.com/news/if-these-walls-could-sing-premieres-at-abbey-road-3283 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230106074715/https://www.abbeyroad.com/news/if-these-walls-could-sing-premieres-at-abbey-road-3283 |archive-date=6 January 2023 |access-date=6 January 2023 |website=AbbeyRoad.com}}</ref>

On 20 June 2023, John said the reaction to [[Phillip Schofield]]'s secret affair with a younger colleague was "totally homophobic", stating: "If it was a straight guy in a fling with a young woman, it wouldn't even make the papers."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Phillip Schofield affair reaction was 'totally homophobic', says Sir Elton John |url=https://news.sky.com/story/phillip-schofield-affair-reaction-was-totally-homophobic-says-sir-elton-john-12905483 |access-date=9 June 2024 |publisher=Sky News |language=en |archive-date=9 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240609135058/https://news.sky.com/story/phillip-schofield-affair-reaction-was-totally-homophobic-says-sir-elton-john-12905483 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 17 July 2023, John gave evidence as a defense witness at [[Kevin Spacey]]'s sexual assault trial.<ref>{{Cite news |date=17 July 2023 |title=Sir Elton John gives evidence in Kevin Spacey trial |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-66222886 |access-date=9 June 2024 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB |archive-date=4 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240504125649/https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-66222886 |url-status=live}}</ref>

In December 2024, [[Madame Tussauds]] revealed a new wax work of John,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elton John |url=https://www.madametussauds.com/london/whats-inside/zones/impossible-festival/elton-john/ |access-date=20 December 2024 |website=Madame Tussauds™ London}}</ref> with it being their most structurally ambitious figure ever. The statue features John in his 1970s heyday as he defies gravity as and is suspended mid-air over his rhinestone piano in his signature handstand move from the era.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Brandle |first=Lars |date=20 December 2024 |title=Elton John's New Waxwork Is High as a Kite |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/music-news/elton-johns-waxwork-madam-tussauds-london-1235861524/ |access-date=20 December 2024 |magazine=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Football ===
{{Quote box
| width = 26%
| align = right
| quote="At the 1984 Cup Final, the song '[[Abide with Me]]' was played and that's why I cried. The song evokes my memory of childhood."
| source = —Elton John on his emotions during the [[FA Cup Final]]'s traditional pre-match hymn.<ref>''An Audience with Elton John''. Sunday 28 September 1997. [[ITV (TV network)|ITV]].</ref>
}}
John became the chairman and director of [[Watford F.C.|Watford]], in 1976, after supporting the team since his youth. John appointed [[Graham Taylor]] as manager and invested large sums of money as the club rose three divisions into the [[Football in England|English]] [[Football League First Division|First Division]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.watfordfc.com/page/History/0,,10400~65917,00.html |title=They shaped the club |publisher=Watford F.C. |access-date=10 March 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081203170637/http://www.watfordfc.com/page/History/0%2C%2C10400~65917%2C00.html |archive-date=3 December 2008}}</ref> At their height, the club finished runners up in the First Division, in 1983, and reached the [[FA Cup Final]], at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]], in 1984. John sold the club to [[Jack Petchey]], in 1987, but remained president.<ref name=WAT />

Ten years later, John repurchased the club from Petchey and once again became chairman. He stepped down, in 2002, when the club needed a full-time chairman, but continued as president.<ref name="WAT" /> Although no longer the majority shareholder, John still holds a significant financial interest. In 2005 and 2010, John held a concert at Watford's home stadium, [[Vicarage Road]], and donated proceeds to the club.<ref name="WAT">{{cite news |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/teams/w/watford/8710452.stm |title=Elton John gig boost for Watford |publisher=BBC |access-date=27 September 2014 |date=28 May 2010 |archive-date=6 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211106025954/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/teams/w/watford/8710452.stm |url-status=live}}</ref>

John has remained friends with a number of high-profile players in [[association football|football]], including [[Pelé]] and [[David Beckham]].<ref name="Warren" /><ref>[http://ego.globo.com/famosos/noticia/2012/09/pele-posta-foto-antiga-com-elton-john.html "Pelé posta foto antiga com Elton John"] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150826172442/http://ego.globo.com/famosos/noticia/2012/09/pele-posta-foto-antiga-com-elton-john.html|date=26 August 2015}}. Globo. Retrieved 8 December 2013.</ref> From late 1975 to 1976, John was a part-owner of the [[Los Angeles Aztecs]] of the [[North American Soccer League (2011–2017)|North American Soccer League]]. On 13 December 2014, he appeared at Watford's Vicarage Road with his husband and sons for the opening of the "Sir Elton John stand".<ref name="Vicarage" /> He called the occasion "one of the greatest days of my life".<ref name="Vicarage">{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-30457777 |title=Sir Elton John has stand named after him at Watford football club |work=BBC News |date=13 December 2014 |access-date=14 December 2014 |archive-date=15 December 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141215223518/http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-30457777 |url-status=live}}</ref>

John's paternal cousin [[Roy Dwight]] was a professional footballer, who scored for [[Nottingham Forest]] in the [[1959 FA Cup Final]] before breaking his leg later in the same match.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.newsshopper.co.uk/news/6340197.roys-bitter-sweet-moment/ |title=Roy's bitter-sweet moment |work=News Shopper |date=23 April 2002 |access-date=12 August 2019 |archive-date=12 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190812022048/https://www.newsshopper.co.uk/news/6340197.roys-bitter-sweet-moment/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Political views ===
[[File:Sir Elton John and President Barack Obama.jpg|thumb|upright=1.2|John and United States President [[Barack Obama]] at the [[White House]], 6 May 2015]]
In 2006, regarding his political views, John said: "If I was to say what I am, I'd be a [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] man. I like [[Tony Blair]] a lot, I think he's a good man. And in America I'd definitely be a [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]]; I'd never be a [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]]."<ref name="hindustantimes">{{cite news |title=Elton John's support for Blair waning |work=Hindustan Times |date=3 August 2006 |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/india/elton-john-s-support-for-blair-waning/story-OQKgfs8XU6TZD3y9rrXiPJ.html |access-date=8 June 2024 |archive-date=14 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240614021438/https://www.hindustantimes.com/india/elton-john-s-support-for-blair-waning/story-OQKgfs8XU6TZD3y9rrXiPJ.html |url-status=live}}</ref> John met Blair at the [[Brit Awards 1998]], where Blair awarded him the Freddie Mercury Award for his charitable work with the [[Elton John AIDS Foundation]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elton's History with the BRIT Awards |url=https://www.eltonjohn.com/stories/elton-at-the-brit-awards-through-the-years/ |access-date=8 June 2024 |website=Elton John |language=en-GB |archive-date=8 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240608083850/https://www.eltonjohn.com/stories/elton-at-the-brit-awards-through-the-years |url-status=live}}</ref> Although John was still fond of Blair as a person, his opinions about Blair's leadership qualities declined over time, and by 2006 he planned to withdraw his support from the Labour Party, saying: "I think it's very hard to be in power for a long time. I think you lose touch. It's that goldfish bowl mentality."<ref name="hindustantimes" />

John was also a friend of Blair's successor [[Gordon Brown]], but despite being called "one of the Labour Party's most stalwart supporters" by ''[[The Daily Telegraph]]'', the newspaper described him as a "floating voter" in 2009.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/newstopics/mandrake/6811802/Now-Gordon-Brown-cant-even-count-on-Sir-Elton-Johns-vote.html |title=Now Gordon Brown can't even count on Sir Elton John's vote |work=The Daily Telegraph |first=Tim |last=Walker |date=14 December 2009 |access-date=27 June 2024 |archive-date=27 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240627173908/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/newstopics/mandrake/6811802/Now-Gordon-Brown-cant-even-count-on-Sir-Elton-Johns-vote.html |url-status=live }}</ref> John announced his intention to vote [[Britain Stronger in Europe|Remain]] during the UK's [[2016 European Union referendum]] on Instagram, sharing an image with the words "build bridges not walls", along with the caption "I'm voting to remain. #StrongerInEurope".<ref>{{Cite news |date=23 March 2019 |title=The celebrities that support Brexit (and the ones backing Remain) |archive-date=27 October 2018 |access-date=27 November 2018 |work=The Independent}}</ref> In 2019, he said the [[Brexit]] vote and the way it had been handled had made him ashamed.<ref>{{cite news |last=Beaumont-Thomas |first=Ben |date=31 May 2019 |title=Elton John: 'I am a European – not a stupid, imperialist English idiot' |access-date=16 September 2019 |newspaper=The Guardian}}</ref> In 2021, John said that his requests to meet with [[Boris Johnson]] regarding Brexit and touring visas for musicians were ignored.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Brereton |first=Greta |date=18 September 2021 |title=Elton John claims Boris Johnson is ignoring his requests to meet about touring visas |url=https://www.nme.com/news/music/elton-john-claims-boris-johnson-is-ignoring-his-requests-to-meet-about-touring-visas-3048894 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221106194342/https://www.nme.com/news/music/elton-john-claims-boris-johnson-is-ignoring-his-requests-to-meet-about-touring-visas-3048894 |archive-date=6 November 2022 |access-date=6 November 2022 |website=NME |language=en-GB}}</ref> In 2023, John addressed a cross-party gathering of politicians at Westminster and said that the winner of the next general election could help to eradicate AIDS worldwide by the end of the decade.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://news.sky.com/story/sir-elton-john-to-mps-next-election-winner-can-help-eradicate-aids-by-2030-13019278 |title=Sir Elton John to MPs: Next election winner can help eradicate AIDS by 2030 |publisher=Sky News |first=Tim |last=Baker |date=29 November 2023 | access-date=2 July 2024}}</ref> He returned to publicly supporting Labour at the [[2024 United Kingdom general election|2024 general election]], endorsing the party's leader [[Keir Starmer]] to become prime minister.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Hardaker |first1=Daniel |last2=Penna |first2=Dominic |last3=Perkins |first3=Liz |date=29 June 2024 |work=The Telegraph |language=en-GB |issn=0307-1235}}</ref> In 2025, he said he felt "incredibly betrayed" by the Labour government over plans to exempt technology firms from copyright laws, saying Starmer needed to "wise up" and describing Technology Secretary [[Peter Kyle]] as "a bit of a moron".<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8jg0348yvxo |title=Elton brands John called President [[George W. Bush]] "the worst thing that ever happened to America" and was "very against the [[Iraq War]]", but later praised Bush as the president who had done the most to combat AIDS.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.today.com/popculture/elton-john-blasts-offat-george-bush-wbna6513847|title=Elton John blasts offat George Bush|website=Today|date=18 November 2004}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://news.yahoo.com/news/blogs/power-players/elton-john-george-w-bush-taught-lesson-040430553.html?guccounter=1&guce_referrer=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29vZ2xlLmNvLnVrLw&guce_referrer_sig=AQAAAGYQPJInRFTIE6a0rKvY4V4QR1YV1rsrfPu9jxj_3Xpw6bjJR3CHFnb5QB8YpCpJ0XDHGPei0XkSZ34oYhWmLS4gZ9-TTXe02DocmvKzb6VuOVK7Z4nTJ8jv6oRNKnmHvkeOwM8pYewzUYGuM130Ym7vI7L-LZoPDxykqaRewBYr |title=Elton John: George W. After his performance, John praised Clinton as "the only choice" America had.<ref>{{cite magazine |title=Elton John, Katy Perry stand for Hillary Clinton at fundraiser |url=https://ew.com/article/2016/03/03/elton-john-katy-perry-hillary-clinton/ |access-date=8 July 2022 |magazine=Entertainment Weekly |archive-date=8 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220708110029/https://ew.com/article/2016/03/03/elton-john-katy-perry-hillary-clinton/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

John was [[Musicians who oppose Donald Trump's use of their music|among 27 artists]] to have opposed [[Donald Trump]]'s use of their music at his campaign rallies, and declined an invitation to attend [[First inauguration of Donald Trump|Trump's inauguration]] in January 2017, stating: "I have given it at lot of thought, and as a British National I don't feel that it's appropriate for me to play at the inauguration of an American President, please accept my apologies." He also exhorted Trump to continue the global fight against HIV/AIDS, and closed his letter by wishing Trump "every success with [[First presidency of Donald Trump|your presidency]]." (magazine)|Variety]]'', John was asked about Trump's use of term to describe Kim, and he responded, "I laughed, I thought it was brilliant."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Shanfeld |first1=Ethan |title=Elton John Says Donald Trump Calling Kim Jong Un 'Little Rocket Man' Was 'Brilliant,' but Urges People to Vote for a 'Calmer, Safer' America |url=https://variety.com/2024/film/news/elton-john-donald-trump-kim-jong-un-nickname-brilliant-rocket-man-1236136630/ |website=Variety |access-date=14 September 2024 |date=7 September 2024}}</ref> 

In 2022, after John performed at the White House, President [[Joe Biden]] surprised him by presenting him with the [[National Humanities Medal]].<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":5" /> Biden said of John: "Like so many Americans, our family loves his music. It's clear Elton John's music has changed our lives." Biden said in his 2017 book ''[[Promise Me, Dad]]'' that he sang "Crocodile Rock" to his son [[Beau Biden|Beau]] when he was a child, and again when he was dying of cancer.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elton John in tears as President Biden surprises him with medal at White House gig |url=https://news.sky.com/story/elton-john-in-tears-as-president-biden-surprises-him-with-medal-at-white-house-gig-12704380 |access-date=8 June 2024 |publisher=Sky News |language=en}}</ref> During the [[2024 United States presidential election]], John assisted Biden at the opening of the [[Stonewall National Monument|Stonewall National Monument Visitor Center]] in New York, the first LGBTQ center in the National Park Service's network.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Kreps |first=Daniel |date=29 June 2024 |title=Watch Elton John Join President Biden at Opening of Stonewall Monument Center |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/elton-john-president-biden-stonewall-monument-center-opening-1235050251/ |access-date=1 July 2024 |magazine=Rolling Stone |language=en-US}}</ref>
[[File:P20220923AS-1670 (52846989568).jpg|thumb|John and United States President [[Joe Biden]] at the White House, 23 September 2022]]
In 2013, John resisted calls to boycott Russia in protest at the [[Russian gay propaganda law]], but told fans at a Moscow concert that the laws were "inhumane and isolating", and he was "deeply saddened and shocked over the current legislation".<ref>{{cite news |last=Michaels |first=Sean |date=9 December 2013 |title=Elton John voices gay rights concerns at Moscow concert |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2013/dec/09/elton-john-moscow-russia-gay-rights?INTCMP=ILCNETTXT3487 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140112065505/http://www.theguardian.com/music/2013/dec/09/elton-john-moscow-russia-gay-rights?INTCMP=ILCNETTXT3487 |archive-date=12 January 2014 |access-date=12 January 2014 |work=The Guardian |location=London, England}}</ref> In a January 2014 interview, Russian President [[Vladimir Putin]] spoke of John in an attempt to show that there was no discrimination against gays in Russia, saying: "Elton John – he's an extraordinary person, a distinguished musician, and millions of our people sincerely love him, regardless of his sexual orientation." John responded by offering to introduce Putin to Russians abused under Russian legislation banning "homosexual propaganda".<ref name="Russia">{{Cite web |date=23 January 2014 |title=Elton John to Putin: I will show you gay people victimised under Russian law |url=http://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/jan/23/elton-john-vladimir-putin-russian-gay-legislation |access-date=6 November 2022 |website=The Guardian |language=en}}</ref> On 24 September 2015, the [[Associated Press]] reported that Putin called John and invited him to meet in the future to discuss [[LGBT rights in Russia]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Puente |first1=Maria |title=Vladimir Putin calls Elton John, this time for real |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/music/2015/09/24/vladimir-putin-called-elton-john-no-really-russians-said-so/72735738/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150926212017/http://www.usatoday.com/story/life/music/2015/09/24/vladimir-putin-called-elton-john-no-really-russians-said-so/72735738/ |archive-date=26 September 2015 |access-date=24 September 2015 |work=USA Today}}</ref>

In October 2020, John called attention to the [[2020 Nagorno-Karabakh conflict|Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]] between [[Armenia]] and [[Azerbaijan]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Armenians deserve lasting peace from years of historical persecution – Elton John makes post demanding peace for Nagorno Karabakh and Armenia |url=https://a1plus.am/en/article/381186 |work=[[A1plus]] |date=5 October 2020 |access-date=11 October 2020 |archive-date=8 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201008073249/https://a1plus.am/en/article/381186 |url-status=live}}</ref> He said in his Instagram post: "In May 2018, I visited [Armenia] and was overwhelmed with the kindness and humanity shown to me by the Armenian people. Now Armenia and [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]] are under attack from unprovoked Azeri/Turkish aggression. Civilians are being targeted and there are needless deaths on both sides."<ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John calls attention to Azerbaijani-Turkish aggression against Artsakh |url=https://en.armradio.am/2020/10/05/elton-john-calls-attention-to-azerbaijani-turkish-aggression-against-artsakh/ |work=Public Radio of Armenia |date=5 October 2020 |access-date=11 October 2020 |archive-date=10 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201010192656/https://en.armradio.am/2020/10/05/elton-john-calls-attention-to-azerbaijani-turkish-aggression-against-artsakh/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 9 December 2022, John left Twitter, following changes to its rules made by new owner [[Elon Musk]], stating: "All my life I've tried to use music to bring people together. Yet it saddens me to see how misinformation is now being used to divide our world. I've decided to no longer use Twitter, given their recent change in policy which will allow misinformation to flourish unchecked."<ref>{{cite tweet |number=1601200277276659712 |user=eltonofficial |title=All my life I've tried to use music to bring people together. Yet it saddens me to see how misinformation is now being used to divide our world. I've decided to no longer use Twitter, given their recent change in policy which will allow misinformation to flourish unchecked. |first=Elton |last=John |author-link=Elton John |date=9 December 2022 |access-date=13 December 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221213020323/https://twitter.com/eltonofficial/status/1601200277276659712 |archive-date=13 December 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref> Musk replied to the post saying: "I love your music. Hope you come back. Is there any misinformation in particular that you're concerned about?"<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hancock |first=Sam |date=10 December 2022 |title=Elton John quits Twitter blaming change in misinformation policy |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-63925416 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240609135058/https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-63925416 |archive-date=9 June 2024 |access-date=9 June 2024 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>

In December 2024, John made public his opposition to [[marijuana legalization]], noting, among other things, his own past drug use.<ref name="time2024iconoftheyear" /> John described the legalization of marijuana [[Cannabis in Canada|in Canada]] and [[Cannabis in the United States|parts of the United States]] "one of the greatest mistakes of our time."<ref name="time2024iconoftheyear">{{cite magazine|url=https://time.com/7201151/icon-of-the-year-2024-elton-john/?linkId=685585144|title=2024 Icon Of The Year -Elton John|first=Belinda|last=Luscombe|magazine=Time|date=12 December 2024|access-date=12 December 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Dunn |first1=Jack |title=Elton John Called the Legalization of Marijuana in America and Canada 'One of the Greatest Mistakes of All Time' |url=https://variety.com/2024/music/news/elton-john-legalization-of-marijuana-greatest-mistakes-of-all-time-1236246690/ |work=Variety |access-date=12 December 2024 |date=11 December 2024}}</ref>

=== Friendship with the British royal family ===
John has performed at a number of events involving the [[British royal family]], such as the [[funeral of Diana, Princess of Wales]] at [[Westminster Abbey]] in 1997, the [[Party at the Palace]] in 2002 and the Queen's [[Diamond Jubilee Concert]] outside [[Buckingham Palace]] in 2012.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 August 2019 |title=Sir Elton John's friendship with the royal family |url=http://www.irishnews.com/magazine/entertainment/2019/08/19/news/sir-elton-john-s-friendship-with-the-royal-family-1689054/ |access-date=26 January 2022 |website=The Irish News |language=en}}</ref> On 4 June 2022, John was projected on to the facade of Buckingham Palace playing "Your Song" (pre-recorded at [[Windsor Castle]]) at the [[Platinum Party at the Palace]] to mark the Queen's [[Platinum Jubilee of Elizabeth II|Platinum Jubilee]].<ref name=":3">{{cite news |title=Elton John performs from Windsor Castle |url=https://www.smh.com.au/world/elton-john-performs-from-windsor-castle-20220605-p5ar4p.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220605081930/https://www.smh.com.au/world/elton-john-performs-from-windsor-castle-20220605-p5ar4p.html |archive-date=5 June 2022 |access-date=24 June 2022 |newspaper=[[The Sydney Morning Herald]]}}</ref> After the [[death of Elizabeth II]] on 8 September 2022, John paid tribute to her during a show by saying "She led the country through some of our greatest and darkest moments with grace, decency and a genuine caring warmth."<ref>{{Cite news |title=Sir Elton John pays tribute to Queen Elizabeth II |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/entertainment-arts-62860047 |access-date=8 June 2024 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> John was close friends with Diana, and has remained close with her sons [[William, Prince of Wales|William]] and [[Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex|Harry]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Katie |date=17 March 2023 |title=Prince Harry's stormy relationship with Elton John after Oscars invite 'snub' |url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/us-celebrity-news/prince-harrys-stormy-relationship-elton-29481801 |access-date=8 June 2024 |website=The Mirror |language=en}}</ref>

=== Health ===

By 1975, the pressures of stardom had begun to take a serious toll on John. During "Elton Week" in Los Angeles that year, he had a [[cocaine overdose]].<ref>"Elton John", Biography Channel, 2005.</ref> He also developed the eating disorder [[bulimia]]. In a 2002 CNN interview with [[Larry King]], King asked if John knew of Diana, Princess of Wales's eating disorder; John replied: "Yes, I did. We were both bulimic."<ref>{{cite news |date=25 January 2002 |title=Larry King Live: Interview With Elton John Aired 25&nbsp;January 2002 |url=http://transcripts.cnn.com/TRANSCRIPTS/0201/25/lkl.00.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210228201858/http://transcripts.cnn.com/TRANSCRIPTS/0201/25/lkl.00.html |archive-date=28 February 2021 |access-date=25 February 2009 |publisher=CNN}}</ref> In a July 2019 Instagram post, John stated he had been sober for 29 years.<ref>{{cite news |date=29 July 2019 |title=Elton John Celebrates 29 Years of Sobriety in Touching Post: 'I Was a Broken Man' |url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/music/celebrity/elton-john-celebrates-29-years-of-sobriety-in-touching-post-i-was-a-broken-man/ar-AAF1oSi |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190729161529/https://www.msn.com/en-us/music/celebrity/elton-john-celebrates-29-years-of-sobriety-in-touching-post-i-was-a-broken-man/ar-AAF1oSi |archive-date=29 July 2019 |access-date=29 July 2019 |work=[[People (magazine)|People]]}}</ref>

At a 2022 concert in [[Indianapolis]], John said he cleaned himself up after spending time with the family of [[Ryan White]]. "I knew that my lifestyle was crazy and out of order. ... I cannot thank them enough, because without them, I'd probably be dead."<ref>{{cite news |date=2 April 2022 |title=Elton John says Ryan White's family saved his life after teen's death |url=https://www.wthr.com/article/news/local/elton-john-ryan-white-tribute-gainbridge-fieldhouse-indianapolis/531-a7937a26-f132-4958-a058-ff80145c1757 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220403185355/https://www.wthr.com/article/news/local/elton-john-ryan-white-tribute-gainbridge-fieldhouse-indianapolis/531-a7937a26-f132-4958-a058-ff80145c1757 |archive-date=3 April 2022 |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=[[WTHR]]}}</ref> In a 2014 interview, he also attributed his sobriety to the [[Kate Bush]] and [[Peter Gabriel]] duet "[[Don't Give Up (Peter Gabriel and Kate Bush song)|Don't Give Up]]" from 1986, in particular the lyric from Bush, "Rest your head. You worry too much. It's going to be all right. When times get rough you can fall back on us. Don't give up." He states, "she [Bush] played a big part in my rebirth. That record helped me so much."<ref>{{cite news |title=Elton John Reveals Kate Bush Song 'Saved His Life' |url=https://www.smoothradio.com/artists/elton-john/elton-john-reveals-kate-bush-song-saved-his-life/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220618092631/https://www.smoothradio.com/artists/elton-john/elton-john-reveals-kate-bush-song-saved-his-life/ |archive-date=18 June 2022 |access-date=14 June 2022 |work=Smooth Radio}}</ref>

On 22 April 2017, John was discharged from hospital after two nights of intensive care for contracting "a harmful and unusual" bacterial infection during his return flight home from a South American tour in [[Santiago]], Chile, and was forced to cancel all his shows scheduled for April and May 2017.<ref>{{cite news |date=24 April 2017 |title=Elton John recovering from 'rare and potentially deadly' infection contracted in South America |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/la-et-entertainment-news-updates-april-elton-john-cancels-vegas-shows-to-1493074904-htmlstory.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181024232124/http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/la-et-entertainment-news-updates-april-elton-john-cancels-vegas-shows-to-1493074904-htmlstory.html |archive-date=24 October 2018 |access-date=17 April 2020 |work=Los Angeles Times}}</ref> In October 2021, John required hip surgery after "falling awkwardly on a hard surface".<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 October 2021 |title=Sir Elton John to have hip surgery after suffering a fall ahead of new tour |url=https://www.ok.co.uk/celebrity-news/sir-elton-john-hip-surgery-25154745 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211022223128/https://www.ok.co.uk/celebrity-news/sir-elton-john-hip-surgery-25154745 |archive-date=22 October 2021 |access-date=22 October 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Wilkins |first=Bridie |date=14 October 2021 |title=Elton John to appear on TV following surgery – details
